Creativity Measures.evidence_source: This is a revised version of the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (Carson, Peterson, & Higgins (2005)) used by Zabelina, Zaonegina, Revelle, & Condon.

Number of studies.evidence_source: The text describes an appendix detailing a questionnaire, not a specific study with a numerical count.

section_summary.extract_value: This appendix describes a revised version of the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), originally developed by Carson, Peterson, & Higgins (2005), which was utilized by Zabelina, Zaonegina, Revelle, & Condon. The section also provides an example item from the questionnaire related to owning or operating a business based on inventions.
